newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sigma started as buy.

text.p: -- Mexican brokerage Interacciones started coverage of processed food leader Sigma Alimentos SA with a buy recommendation.

-- Analyst Isabel Rueda said that despite Sigma shares being comparitively more expensive than others in the food sector and the Mexican equity market overall, Interacciones recommended the stock as a buy.
-- "The price paid for Sigma is justified because of the efficient operations structure of the company and growth outlook," she said.
-- Rueda estimated Sigma sales growth of 11 percent, 7.6 percent and 7.6 percent in 1996, 1997 and 1998.
